example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা চারশ বিশ লোক, কখনো তার কথায় বিশ্বাস করিস না।
বাজারে এই চারশ বিশদের থেকে সাবধানে থাকতে হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real 420 guy; never trust his words.
You have to be careful of these swindlers in the market.
history: Refers to Section 420 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), which punishes cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property, originating from British colonial law in 1860.
note: This idiom is widely used in Bengali and broader Indian contexts as slang for fraudulent individuals, popularized through media and everyday speech.
